top_signals.title: Europe’s Bond-Spread Blowout Prompts Bets on Fewer ECB Hikes
top_signals.summary: A surge in euro-area sovereign bond spreads slowed on Friday as traders bet the European Central Bank will be forced to support the region’s more-indebted members by delivering fewer interest-rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan AM: We're Getting More Constructive on Duration
top_signals.summary: Kim Crawford, global fixed income portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, discusses the outlook for French bond yields and why her firm is getting "more constructive" on longer-term debt. "Bonds typically sell off until something breaks, and something has broken," Crawford tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
